units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b:15">B. Mets. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>דאִישְּׁדּוּף רובא דבאגא</he> when most of the fields of the valley were struck; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:4">ib. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אִשְׁתַּדּוּף רובא וכ׳</he> most of the fields … were struck, and also his barley was blasted.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:6">Ib.</cite> (mixed dict.) <he>דהא מִשְׁתַּדְּפוּ כל שדותיך</he> for all thy fields have been struck; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 18:27">Targ. I Kings XVIII, 27</cite> (h. text <cite ref="U00814"><he>שִׂיג</he></cite>).
